pages.title: A green button · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday evening in a quiet house in Boston. Dad sits at the kitchen table with a laptop. His daughter Mia studies in another city. They talk by video every Sunday. He presses the green call button. The screen flickers and then a face appears.
“Hi, Dad! Can you see me?” says Mia. “Yes, but I can’t hear you. The sound is off.” says Dad. “Oh no. Can you hear me now?” says Mia.
